sites.name: סטי"ל

s1.quote: she lies in a depth of 25 meters and the average dive depth ranges from 20 to max. 30 meters … The underwater visibility in the area is very good as it exceeds 15 meters.

s2.quote: This is a wreck dive to 24m which can be made at any time of day. … Ramp access to the water from the northernmost corner of Village Beach … reaches a depth of 12m

s3.quote: The main deck sits at roughly 72 ft (22 m), and the deepest point of the wreck is around 75 ft (23 m). … Advanced Open Water

access.value: Shore entry via ramp at Village Beach, Eilat

penetration.value: Semi-penetration at bow and stern; some parts sealed

highlights.text: Bridge covered in soft purple coral

summary.text: A decommissioned Israeli Navy missile boat sunk off Eilat in 1994 as a reef. It sits upright on sand a short swim from Village Beach, with a bridge near 12 m and a deck around 20 m, and parts of the interior can be explored.

sites.depthNote: Bridge 12 m, bow 18 m, stern 21 m, sand about 24-25 m
